narrationTexts: I'll start by exploring the codebase.
finalText:
**Bigger than a rename.** `1291` hits, `94` files.

Safe to rename: JS locals in `services/`. That is most of it.

| Must not rename | Hits | Why |
|---|---|---|
| SQL in `**/repo/*.js` | 125 | real DB column |
| `req.session.account_id` | 100 | session set outside this repo |
| `migrations/` | 61 | applied in prod, history |
| `JSON.stringify` payload key | 25 | stored JSONB key |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | 20 | `npm run vendor:refresh` overwrites |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 5 | public contract, breaking |
| [serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) wire value | 1 | frozen public name |

Next: sign only if those stay frozen.
